definitions.explanation: Items made from processed animal hide (leather), such as bags, wallets, belts, shoes, and jackets.

examples.japanese: {革製品|かわせいひん}は{手入|てい}れが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Taking care of leather goods is important.

examples.japanese: イタリア{製|せい}の{革製品|かわせいひん}をお{土産|みやげ}に{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought Italian leather goods as souvenirs.

examples.japanese: {質|しつ}の{良|よ}い{革製品|かわせいひん}は{使|つか}い{込|こ}むほど{味|あじ}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Quality leather goods develop more character the more you use them.

notes:
A compound of {革|かわ} (leather) and {製品|せいひん} (product, manufactured goods). The kanji {革|かわ} specifically means processed animal hide (leather), as opposed to {皮|かわ} which refers to raw skin or hide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革製品|かわせいひん}の{手入|てい}れ: leather care
- {革製品|かわせいひん}の{修理|しゅうり}: leather repair
- {本革|ほんがわ}{製品|せいひん}: genuine leather products

RELATED WORDS:
- {革|かわ}: leather — the material itself
- {皮革|ひかく}: leather and hides — a more formal/technical term covering both raw and processed materials
- {合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}: synthetic leather, faux leather — imitation leather made from synthetic materials
- {製品|せいひん}: product — also used in other compounds like {乳製品|にゅうせいひん} (dairy products)
